heroPreview.subtitle: Permukaan ini bukan pratonton papan pemuka. Ia ialah ekstrak rasmi tentang cara Afenda menukar pergerakan operasi kepada kebenaran perniagaan kanonik yang boleh dioperasikan, ditadbir dan diaudit.

ledger.description: Setiap peristiwa operasi mesti melepasi pengikatan identiti, penilaian dasar dan pelampiran bukti sebelum dibenarkan menggerakkan keadaan perniagaan.

resolved.title: Keadaan operasi diselesaikan
resolved.description: Afenda tidak menambah satu lagi lapisan tafsiran. Ia menyelesaikan keadaan yang boleh dioperasikan, dipertahankan dan diselaraskan oleh perniagaan.
resolved.body: Keadaan yang diterima dibataskan kepada penyewa, diikat kepada pelaku, diuji oleh dasar dan disambungkan kepada bukti yang diperlukan untuk menerangkan sebab ia wujud.

auditPosture.value: Dihasilkan oleh operasi, bukan dibina semula kemudian

consequence.label: Akibat perniagaan
consequence.title: Tiada penyelamatan naratif selepas fakta berlaku.
consequence.body: Sistem memaksa kebenaran dihasilkan pada saat operasi berlaku, supaya kewangan, audit, pengurusan dan pelaksanaan bekerja daripada rekod diselesaikan yang sama.

system.title: Afenda is not a feature surface. It is the canonical layer beneath operational judgment.
system.description: The product exists to prevent the familiar enterprise failure: useful activity spread across tools, but no single accountable record strong enough for decision, audit, and control.

recordDiscipline.label: Record discipline
recordDiscipline.title: Every operational event resolves into a governed source of truth.
recordDiscipline.body: Afenda treats documents, entities, actions, approvals, and state transitions as durable business facts, not as disconnected interface activity.

evidenceBinding.label: Evidence binding
evidenceBinding.title: The system keeps proof close to the decision it supports.
evidenceBinding.body: A decision without lineage is only a claim. Afenda binds actor, time, tenant, source, reason, and resulting state into a traceable operating layer.

resolutionControl.label: Resolution control
resolutionControl.title: Conflicting activity is resolved by policy, not by memory.
resolutionControl.body: When systems disagree, the operating model needs precedence, auditability, and controlled mutation. Afenda is built around that discipline.

topology.title: Satu saluran isyarat mentah ke rekod yang boleh dipertahankan.
topology.description: Afenda tidak mencabarkan kebenaran merentas alat. Input dinormalisasi, dinilai dalam teras resolusi, dan dikeluarkan sebagai keadaan kanonik dengan keterlihatan audit.
topology.thesis: Jika organisasi tidak boleh melukis garisan ini pada satu gambarajah, ia tidak mempunyai satu kebenaran operasi—hanya tafsiran yang dipertikaikan.

identity.title: Isyarat identiti
identity.body: Pelakon, penyewa, dan konteks pemilikan sebagai fakta peringkat pertama.

skills.title: Graf keupayaan
skills.body: Kemahiran, kemahiran, dan struktur tenaga kerja sebagai atribut teratur.

knowledge.title: Objek pengetahuan

identityBinding.title: Pengikatan identiti
identityBinding.body: Setiap peralihan terikat pelakon dan penyewa sebelum dasar dijalankan.

policyResolution.title: Resolusi dasar
policyResolution.body: Autoriti, pendahuluan, dan peraturan menentukan keadaan yang boleh berubah.

evidenceCommit.title: Komit bukti
evidenceCommit.body: Bukti dilampirkan semasa rekod ditulis—bukan dicipta semula kemudian.

consequence.label: Akibat reka bentuk
consequence.title: Tiada autoriti selari.
consequence.body: Jika saluran boleh mengubah kebenaran perniagaan tanpa merentasi tulang belakang ini, Afenda sengaja tidak menganggapnya teratur.

surface.title: The interface is reduced to what the organization must know, prove, and control.
surface.description: No decorative dashboards. No synthetic theatre. The operational surface exists to expose canonical records, policy decisions, evidence links, and state movement.

integrationReality.title: Sistem luar menyumbang isyarat. Afenda mengekalkan autoriti.
integrationReality.description: ERP, HRIS, identiti, dan kolaborasi kekal sebagai sumber—bukan buku besar kebenaran bersaing. Setiap laluan masuk merentasi skop identiti, normalisasi, tadbir urus, dan disiplin komit.
integrationReality.quote: Integrasi membuktikan apa yang memasuki sempadan—bukan apa yang perniagaan dibenarkan percaya.

systems.body: Workday, SAP, BambooHR, ATS, LMS, tiket—dimasukkan sebagai sumber teratur ber-cap masa.

knowledge.body: Objek Confluence, Notion, Drive didaftarkan dengan pemilikan, sensitiviti, dan teg dasar.

governance.title: Penguatkuasaan tadbir urus
governance.body: Pek peraturan, rantaian kelulusan, pecah kaca, dan pengesanan hanyut sebelum keadaan maju.

boundary.title: Urutan tanpa pintasan
boundary.description: Setiap peringkat wajib. Melangkau peringkat bukan pilihan konfigurasi—ia kontrak integrasi yang gagal.

connect.label: Sambung
connect.value: Penyambut disahkan dengan rahsia least-privilege dan skop eksplisit.

normalize.label: Normalisasi
normalize.value: Pemetaan skema, penduplikasian, dan bendera konflik sebelum dasar.

govern.label: Tadbir urus
govern.value: Dasar, kelulusan, dan pengecualian dinilai dengan keperluan bukti.

consequence.label: Peraturan operasi
consequence.title: Integrasi tidak mendapat pintu sisi ke kebenaran.
consequence.body: Jika vendor atau aliran bayangan tidak boleh menunjukkan resit yang sama, ia bukan sebahagian model operasi teratur—tanpa mengira keselesaan UI.

input.title: Peristiwa masuk sebagai fakta membawa bukti.
input.description: Dokumen, tindakan, integrasi, identiti, dan perubahan keadaan ditangkap dengan konteks mencukupi untuk dinilai kemudian.

control.title: Dasar menentukan autoriti dan pendahuluan.
control.description: Sistem menilai skop penyewa, autoriti peranan, kebolehpercayaan sumber, dan ikatan peraturan sebelum keadaan dibenarkan bergerak.

truth.title: Rekod kanonik diselesaikan dan disimpan.
truth.description: Keadaan terhasil boleh diperiksa, diaudit, dan digunakan merentas organisasi tanpa bergantung pada penjelasan manual.

domains.title: Capabilities are expressed as enterprise controls, not feature cards.
domains.description: Each domain answers one question: what can the organization rely on when operational pressure, system disagreement, and audit scrutiny arrive together?

canonicalRecords.title: Canonical records
canonicalRecords.body: Operational entities, documents, events, and transitions are normalized into accountable records with stable ownership, scope, and identity.
canonicalRecords.proof: Reduces duplicate truth surfaces and prevents record drift across teams, tools, and tenants.

evidenceBinding.title: Evidence binding
evidenceBinding.body: Every material state carries the proof required to defend it: source, actor, timestamp, reason, tenant boundary, and decision path.
evidenceBinding.proof: Turns operational claims into inspectable facts before audit pressure arrives.

governanceControls.title: Governance controls
governanceControls.body: Policy, role, approval, precedence, and exception handling are treated as first-class controls rather than implementation comments.
governanceControls.proof: Keeps operational change inside a controlled spine instead of relying on informal process memory.

auditContinuity.title: Audit continuity
auditContinuity.body: The system preserves the path from original event to current state, including reversals, overrides, and resolution authority.
auditContinuity.proof: Supports executive review, regulatory inspection, and internal accountability without narrative reconstruction.

operationalResolution.title: Operational resolution
operationalResolution.body: When incoming facts conflict, Afenda resolves them through declared precedence, tenant scope, and evidence quality.
operationalResolution.proof: Prevents the business from manually negotiating which system should be believed.

enterpriseIntegration.title: Enterprise integration
enterpriseIntegration.body: External systems connect as sources and consumers of truth, not as uncontrolled parallel ledgers.
enterpriseIntegration.proof: Allows ERP, identity, document, and workflow systems to participate without fragmenting authority.

commercial.title: Sedia perolehan tanpa teater perolehan.
commercial.description: Afenda menyelaraskan undang-undang, keselamatan, dan pelaksana pada fakta seni bina yang sama: autoriti terbatas, bukti dikekalkan, dan satu postur rekod kanonik.

implementation.body: Onboarding berfasa dengan rollback jelas, pintu validasi, dan kriteria kejayaan terikat rekod kanonik.

security.body: Putaran rahsia, pengikatan SSO, keturunan audit tidak berubah, penghalaan anomali didokumentasikan—bukan hanya diwar-warkan.

commercial.title: Struktur komersial
commercial.body: Kapasiti, peringkat sokongan, dan sempadan liabiliti terhadap kawalan ciri sebenar—tiada SKU rak.

process.description: Setiap langkah menghasilkan artefak bertandatangan. Tiada yang bergantung pada narasi kosong.

align.label: Selaraskan
align.value: Undang-undang, IT, dan pihak eksekutif menandatangani pakej seni bina yang sama.

commit.label: Komit

consequence.title: Kontrak merujuk seni bina—bukan slaid.
consequence.body: Apabila pertikaian atau audit tiba, kedua-dua pihak menjejaki obligasi ke kawalan tersenarai dan rekod tidak berubah—bukan tuntutan pemasaran yang ditafsir semula.

guarantees.title: Credibility comes from what the system can prove under pressure.
guarantees.description: The guarantee is not speed, dashboards, or generic automation. The guarantee is that the organization can inspect how an operational state became true.

canonicalState.title: One canonical state
canonicalState.body: The business does not need three reports and a meeting to decide which record is true.

decisionPath.title: Traceable decision path
decisionPath.body: Every material decision can be followed through actor, source, policy, reason, and resulting state.

tenantBounded.title: Tenant-bounded records
tenantBounded.body: Records remain scoped to the correct tenant, legal entity, operating boundary, and authority model.

auditReady.title: Audit-ready evidence
auditReady.body: Evidence is retained as part of the operational record, not collected later as a separate rescue exercise.

controlledChange.title: Controlled change
controlledChange.body: Overrides, exceptions, and reversals move through visible governance rather than hidden operational shortcuts.

integrationDiscipline.title: Integration discipline
integrationDiscipline.body: Connected systems exchange truth through controlled boundaries instead of becoming competing authorities.

evidence.title: Kepercayaan adalah sifat rekod—bukan dek slaid.
evidence.description: Afenda menjadikan bukti struktural: pengikatan identiti, penilaian dasar, komit kanonik, dan keterlihatan audit adalah peringkat kelihatan, bukan nota tambahan.
evidence.quote: Jika tidak boleh dikesan, ia bukan bukti—ia pendapat.

consequence.label: Postur audit
consequence.title: Hutang bukti terkumpul—Afenda melunaskan semasa menulis.
consequence.body: Organisasi yang menangguh tangkapan bukti membayar faedah majemuk pada setiap audit, pertikaian, atau peralihan kepimpinan berikutnya. Bukti struktural mengelak trajektori itu.

closing.title: The system either knows the truth, or the business negotiates it manually.
closing.description: Afenda is designed for the former: a governed truth layer where operational records survive growth, integration pressure, tenant complexity, and executive review without requiring narrative rescue.

readiness.title: Enterprise adoption begins with evidence, scope, and operating discipline.
readiness.description: These are the questions the product is built to answer before procurement, rollout, or executive sponsorship creates pressure.

replacement.question: What does Afenda replace?
replacement.answer: Afenda does not begin as a replacement for ERP, document storage, or workflow tools. It establishes the truth layer that governs how operational facts become reliable records across those systems.

start.question: Where does implementation start?
start.answer: Implementation starts with the highest-risk truth surface: records where conflicting sources, manual reconciliation, approval ambiguity, or audit exposure already create operational cost.

integrations.question: How does Afenda handle integrations?
integrations.answer: Integrations are treated as governed sources and consumers. They are not allowed to silently create a second authority without identity, scope, precedence, and evidence rules.

enterpriseGrade.question: What makes this enterprise-grade?
enterpriseGrade.answer: The enterprise posture comes from tenant boundaries, evidence retention, audit continuity, policy-driven state transitions, and a product model that treats control as architecture rather than an afterthought.

executiveReview.question: How should executives evaluate the product?
executiveReview.answer: Evaluate whether Afenda can explain who changed what, why it changed, which source was trusted, whose authority applied, when the state became true, and how the evidence survives review.

executiveClose.title: Langkah seterusnya adalah semakan seni bina—bukan demo lagi.
executiveClose.description: Afenda menerbitkan ontologi yang sama untuk perolehan, pembina, auditor, dan operator. Putuskan sama ada satu tulang belakang kebenaran struktural lebih baik daripada kos penyelarasan yang meningkat.

governance.title: Dossier tadbir urus
governance.body: Pek dasar, overlay RACI, gambarajah segregasi, kerangka DPIA—dieksport sebagai bungkusan berversi.

review.title: Memo semakan pasukan merah
review.body: Delta pentest pihak ketiga, kawalan kriptografi, keputusan latihan rantai anomaly.

close.label: Pos pemeriksaan keputusan
close.title: Tiada ketidaktahuan seni bina yang tinggal?
close.body: Jika apa-apa masih “akan ditakrif dalam pelaksanaan,” semakan belum lengkap—skala tidak membaiki kawalan kabur.

index.title: Marketing Footer Legal Documents
index.description: Central index of all individual footer legal, compliance, and authority documents. Each page is structured for counsel review and evidentiary traceability.

documentation.title: Documentation Access Record
documentation.subtitle: Controlled entry point to product, architecture, and governance documentation.
documentation.purpose: Provides the formal footer-linked documentation entry while preserving a traceable legal and governance context.
documentation.responseStandard: Documentation access is immediate; citation clarifications follow legal desk standards.

sections.heading: Document Scope
paragraphs: This page routes readers to official product documentation and related governance references without ambiguity.

sections.heading: Operational Link
paragraphs: Authoritative documentation remains published at the main docs endpoint.

book-demo.title: Demo Engagement Docket
book-demo.subtitle: Formal intake channel for demonstration and technical qualification sessions.
book-demo.purpose: Provides a footer-governed pathway for scheduling a platform demonstration with traceable request intent.
book-demo.responseStandard: Demo intake acknowledgments and scheduling windows are issued by commercial operations.

sections.heading: Engagement Inputs
paragraphs: Include operational objective, stakeholder roles, and priority workflows to structure the demonstration session.

sections.heading: Operational Link
paragraphs: The active scheduling workflow remains available through the demo endpoint.

architecture-review.title: Architecture Review Intake Memorandum
architecture-review.subtitle: Technical governance intake for regulated processing environments.
architecture-review.purpose: Establishes the submission protocol for architecture-risk review, control mapping, and evidentiary adequacy prior to deployment.
architecture-review.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; substantive triage memorandum within 7 business days.

sections.heading: Required Submission Record
paragraphs: Submit a system diagram, data-flow narrative, and decision log that identifies controller, processor, and sub-processor roles.

sections.heading: Review Output
paragraphs: Review outcomes include control sufficiency findings, remediation directives, and evidentiary gaps requiring closure before production approval.

security-contact.title: Security Contact Protocol
security-contact.subtitle: Primary channel for security assessment and control assurance requests.
security-contact.purpose: Defines intake and handling rules for security questionnaires, control attestations, and trust-center requests.
security-contact.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 1 business day; complete response package subject to scope and NDA status.

sections.heading: Submission Scope
paragraphs: Requests must identify control family, intended regulatory use, and evidence period to ensure accurate retrieval of records.

sections.heading: Disclosure Basis
paragraphs: Evidence is released under least-disclosure principle and contractual confidentiality obligations.

compliance-packet.title: Compliance Packet Request
compliance-packet.subtitle: Formal request channel for regulatory and audit evidence packs.
compliance-packet.purpose: Provides standardized packet assembly for due diligence, audit preparation, and procurement governance.
compliance-packet.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; packet assembly timeline communicated after scope validation.

sections.heading: Packet Components
paragraphs: Compliance packets may include policy indices, control matrices, subprocessors, and incident reporting posture statements.

sections.heading: Verification Controls
paragraphs: Requests are subject to requester identity verification and legitimate purpose assessment.

dpa-request.title: Data Processing Addendum Request
dpa-request.subtitle: Contractual pathway for controller-processor terms and transfer safeguards.
dpa-request.purpose: Initiates DPA negotiation and execution with jurisdictional annexes and transfer mechanism schedules.
dpa-request.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; redline review sequence confirmed after template intake.

sections.heading: Contracting Requirements
paragraphs: Provide legal entity details, role allocation, subprocessors constraints, and required transfer mechanism clauses.

sections.heading: Cross-Border Safeguards
paragraphs: Transfer clauses must identify destination jurisdictions, legal basis, and supplementary measures where applicable.

privacy-request.title: Privacy Request Desk
privacy-request.subtitle: Unified intake channel for privacy notices, policy interpretation, and data handling questions.
privacy-request.purpose: Records and routes privacy governance requests to legal and operational reviewers under documented intake controls.
privacy-request.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; response schedule set after issue classification.

sections.heading: Request Classes
paragraphs: Includes notice interpretation, lawful-basis clarification, retention policy inquiries, and transparency obligations.

sections.heading: File Integrity
paragraphs: All requests are logged with timestamped references to preserve audit traceability.

terms-request.title: Terms and Contract Desk
terms-request.subtitle: Formal channel for terms review, contract clarifications, and legal language requests.
terms-request.purpose: Centralizes legal drafting and interpretation requests related to contractual terms governing service usage.
terms-request.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; legal analysis turnaround by complexity class.

sections.heading: Drafting Inputs
paragraphs: Identify clause references, redline intent, and governing-law requirements in each submission.

sections.heading: Version Control
paragraphs: Issued drafts preserve revision history to maintain negotiation traceability.

investor-relations.title: Investor Relations Legal Channel
investor-relations.subtitle: Governance disclosures and legal response stream for investor diligence.
investor-relations.purpose: Provides controlled access to governance statements and legally reviewable representations for financing diligence.
investor-relations.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 3 business days; disclosure pack subject to eligibility and confidentiality screening.

sections.heading: Disclosure Preconditions
paragraphs: Requests must provide fund identity, diligence purpose, and executed confidentiality terms.

sections.heading: Disclosure Scope
paragraphs: Responses exclude privileged material and unpublished strategic matters unless expressly authorized.

legal-desk.title: Office of General Counsel
legal-desk.subtitle: Primary legal operations desk for statutory interpretation and governance directives.
legal-desk.purpose: Handles legal citations, interpretation requests, and jurisdictional applicability analyses for published statements.
legal-desk.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; legal memorandum issuance based on scope complexity.

sections.heading: Legal Citation Handling
paragraphs: Citation requests are answered with law/section precision and source traceability.

sections.heading: Publication Governance
paragraphs: External legal statements are reviewed for statutory accuracy before release.

data-subject-rights.title: Data Subject Rights Desk
data-subject-rights.subtitle: Operational intake for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, and objection rights.
data-subject-rights.purpose: Registers and executes verified rights requests under documented identity and authority controls.
data-subject-rights.responseStandard: Acknowledgment within 2 business days; statutory response timelines applied by governing jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Identity Verification
paragraphs: Rights fulfillment requires identity verification proportionate to the sensitivity of requested actions.

sections.heading: Execution Record
paragraphs: Each request receives a dated execution log, legal basis record, and completion status.
